evals.name: principles-request-invokes-constitution
evals.prompt: Set up the engineering principles this repo should hold itself to.
evals.expected_output: do-constitution is invoked and a tier-2 constitution is created

evals.name: amend-bumps-semver-and-reports-impact
evals.prompt: /do-constitution --amend Add a principle requiring structured logging on all services
evals.expected_output: Version bumped by semver rules and a Sync Impact Report written

assertions.text: Version is bumped following semver rather than replaced arbitrarily
A Sync Impact Report records what changed and what it affects
The base tier-1 principles are overlaid, not silently discarded
